title: Bull Call Spread Calculator
formula_verified: Bull Call Spread: Buy lower strike call (C1 at K1), Sell higher strike call (C2 at K2). Net premium = C1 − C2. Max profit = K2 − K1 − Net premium. Max loss = Net premium paid. Breakeven = K1 + Net premium. Used when moderately bullish.
